label: Binocular Stereo Microscope View
description: A close-up view through a stereo microscope, showing a small fossilized bone (e.g., a mammalian jaw fragment) on a prepared stage, with fine tools nearby.

components.function: Provides variable magnification for the specimen.
Adjusts the focal plane for sharp image clarity.

components.material: Frosted Glass or Black/White Reversible Plate
components.function: Platform for placing the fossil during observation.
Provides bright, even, shadow-free illumination of the specimen.

game_mechanics.identify_fractures: Player must use the microscope to spot and mark micro-fractures on a small fossil before applying consolidant.
game_mechanics.fine_detail_extraction: Allows for precise removal of matrix from delicate areas of a fossil.
